name: clicktronix-development-flow
sensitive_surfaces: public APIs, persisted schemas, and cross-service contracts
money, payments, pricing, billing, and entitlements
infrastructure, CI, deployment, and release configuration
security-relevant input handling: injection, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, and server-side allowlists

invariants.requirement: Run executes a committed specification and never reconstructs one from chat.
Each specification owns one named task branch and one pull request.
A behavior change demonstrates the specified regression check failing for the expected reason before the fix and passing afterward, or records an explicit non-code alternative.
Every required review approval records the exact candidate commit and tree; invocation or partial output is not approval.
Any candidate change returns the run to implementation and invalidates prior testing, acceptance, review, CI, and DoD evidence.
Required hosted checks are green on the exact current pull-request head and reviewed candidate SHA.
All pre-merge Definition of Done evidence is complete and bound to the candidate before merge is allowed.
